$comment: World-tick events for Aeldran. Source: docs/design/world-events.md. Runtime scheduling (cron, priority arbitration, flag writes) lives in C#; this file is the authoring surface.

events.description: Scarcity bites after a long quiet stretch. Surplus-holders price up; guards shift from poaching patrols to grain escort.

trigger.prose: 14+ in-game days without a raid event anywhere AND player has Trusted+ with any single faction.

effects.text: The road's hungry this week. Drinks stay the same, stew's a copper up, don't look at me like that.
food-cart ambush, third this month.

events.displayName: Rider Dust-Up at the Bent Mare
events.description: Two Riders of opposed factional sympathies lodge the same night. A road-event gets quietly handled; a stool gets broken.

trigger.prose: Two Rider NPCs within Eastmile node on a given tick with reputation-lean values of opposite sign > 500.

effects.text: You missed the show. Two of yours. The broken stool is yours to replace.

events.description: Ewan Truce files a report. Marchkeep entries now require on-the-spot assay; Thornwood-coded items get confiscated at a 10% roll.

trigger.prose: Raising Thornwood rep into Trusted while player visited Marchkeep within the last 10 days.

effects.text: My orders are my orders, Rider. I recommend a different road this month.
They took my nephew's ring. I will be cold about it. Tea?

events.description: The Ashen Court's build-out cadence. A new Dream-relay node appears in a zone the player has not visited recently — defaced shrine or milestone.

effects.text: A milestone stone, defaced with a spiral of ashmark — fresh.
Bad dream last night. The kind that leaves a smell.
Mabon's fur is up, which is never a compliment. Go look.

events.description: Every seventh day. Dravenite and bog-iron halved; smugglers thicken; Lieutenant Varn is always on duty (useful to players avoiding him).

effects.text: Market day. I shall be insufferable — I will have had breakfast.

events.description: First frost. Wildfolk pass through Thornwood Verge three times as often but 70% non-hostile; wolves push into Eastmile farmland.

effects.text: The Autumn's in. You'll want the back-room chair.
The wood is travelling. Don't startle it.

events.description: Maren re-emerges. Ashen-Reach access opens for Trusted+; all Dream-relay nodes become readable. Thornwood and Caervorn both call closed councils.

trigger.prose: Trusted+ with one of the Three AND at least one Ashen thread touched AND 60-day floor since Chain 1 Beat 4 resolution.

effects.text: (silence — this is the tell)

events.description: Thenna Orys, 17, Halven Orys's niece, begins receiving Dream-contact. 5-day window to intercept; otherwise she joins the Ashen Reach voluntarily.

trigger.prose: 30 days after any player touches the Compact faction AND canon-deliberations Q3 conservative ruling holds.

effects.text: Generous tonight. Something on my mind.
There's a girl thinking at the wrong frequency. Go listen.

events.description: A sealed Caervorn dispatch rides to Marchkeep-adjacent garrisons. Contents vary by Chain 3 branch.

trigger.prose: 3 days after Chain 3 Beat 4 resolves (any branch).

effects.text: Moody. If you caused my interview, no tea this week.

events.description: Compact factors audit the player's next sale. Legitimate -> +25 Compact. Dodgy -> -100 Compact and a 20% fine.

trigger.prose: Player has sold goods worth over 500 silver total in any single zone's market within 30 days, regardless of faction lean.

effects.text: A friendly word. We'll want to see the next ledger line.

events.description: Travel times on non-King's-Road routes +25%. Bogs in Gravenmarsh freeze unevenly — random causeway closures.

effects.text: The road's grumpy today.
Brief. Go.
Ink freezes. I write anyway.

events.description: Once per lunar cycle. Rhianne Moss attends. A rare Working is performed; contribute at Honored+ for a rotating minor benefit.

trigger.prose: Every 28 in-game days, if player has Known+ with Thornwood AND visited the Thornwood Verge within 7 days.

effects.text: Come tomorrow. Or don't. Don't knock.
